newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU slams Belarus over arrests.
newsitem.headline: EU slams Belarus over arrests.

text.p: European Union foreign ministers sharply criticised Belarus on Tuesday charging that the government of President Alexander Lukashenko was conducting arbitrary arrests and ignoring international norms.
In a statement, the ministers warned that cooperation between the EU and Belarus could not proceed without action by Minsk.
"The EU expresses its deep concern at a wave of arbitrary arrests of demonstrators and members of the opposition in recent weeks," it said.

"(The arrests) raise doubt on the declared willingness of the (Belarus) government to work constructively with the European Union and relevant international organisations towards establishing a political system which respects the...norms for human rights and political freedoms," it said.
